title.rendered: Earl Wilkinson, INMA Executive advising media CEOs worldwide came to PUNCH.

content.rendered:
Earl J. Wilkinson has spent decades in the rooms where the future of journalism gets decided.

As the Executive Director and CEO of the International News Media Association (INMA), the global body shaping news media strategy across 130+ countries; he knows what’s working, what’s dying, and what African media can’t afford to get wrong.

Yesterday, he came to PUNCH Place.

We also asked him about AI, trust, revenue, and whether print has a future.

Watch the full conversation.
